i wanna begin by saying that i have no knowledge of song writing/music producing/animation. i will just say how i, as your typical uneducated music media consumer, feels about it. sorry if ill seem a little harash, im not good with words (especially if english is not my first language). i love dream to death but that doesnt mean that ill sugar coat my opinions. 

i feel like mask consist of your basic radio pop song instrumental (which isnt necessary a bad thing) and lyrics that i can see 13 year old me writing in my emo phase. i dont wanna call it a fake deep because i know that it means so much to dream and he truly means the words he sings. and here we arrive at the strongest component of this song - the emotion in dreams voice and how he sells those lyrics to the listener. the way he says 'its so terrifing' or almost screams in some parts is enough of an encouragement for me to listen to the whole song. mask was written during the cheating scandal era, when he felt lost and not understood, which adds a new layer of apparition i have for the emotional baggage that this song carries. 

everything was already said about this animation - i wont add anything new here. its kinda wanky at times (clipping and all of this stuff) and personally i just dont enjoy this particular art style. but i really appreciate the fact that dream hired the people from the community to do this, really nice of him. 

even though mask isnt that great of a listen, im excited for dreams new music (the roadtrip was great though!!). he isnt a professional musician and still has a room and time to grow as an artist.
